reviews.text: I have been here a couple of times and the experience has been great. Small shop but deceiving as it has plenty of variety. The staff are top, have the knowledge and 100% customer first mentality. Feels like they care about the community, and their customers.

Very helpful by making sure you're purchasing the correct parts for you're specific model of the vehicle ,
Really pleased with the pricing of the parts I needed compared to what I was expecting after looking up some rough estimates online ,highly recommend this place to all as a regular customer myself for far too many years to want to think about.

I have been using beacon for many years and found them it be very helpful and knowledgeable and friendly. They do have a good selection of aquatic fish and fresh water fish and accessories and if you don't see it they will order it in for you  5 star
Very helpful everyone I go and the staff are very reliable and has genuine knowledge of how to treat animals. Thank you very much as I do appreciate it.

I went to buy a fish for my aquarium and it was amazing place and they gave me proper advice for fish and fish tank . Dez was amazing to guide . I suggest you this place to visit once if you like pets .
Thank you dez .

The young man behind the counter couldn't have been more helpful. He is a star. He even said I could bring my dog to pick her own treats next time as she wasn't with me, and gave his best advice for picky dogs. Very knowledgeable and an amazing selection of natural treats available. What a jem he is. So polite made me feel welcome.
Excellent pet shop that's easily missed it's well worth poping into. There's a food variety of fish, the staff are friendly and very knowledgeable. This will be my main place to go for now on.
Very friendly and excellent service. I bought some otocinclus catfish from here and it is doing great. Highly recommend this place for healthy fish and great customer care.
Brilliant place, if they don't have it they will order it

I went into this shop with my grandson and the young woman behind the counter (Kiddy?) was really knowledgeable and helpful about keeping tropical fish, tanks and setting one up. She was helpful but not pushy. Great customer service. Thank you!
Extremely helpful and friendly would definitely recommend this shop💗 …

Kiddy&Dez, simply the best your find for customer service!
They are friendly, helpful and really care.
No other pet shop can match these two!!
Very accommodating and knowledgeable staff, I was served by Mendez and Alex. Reasonably priced and offer a lot more pet supplies for more exotic pets.

Very good pet shop and very helpful staff been in today to look at fish had help from Mendez and Alex I brought a couple of live plants and fish they was both very friendly and helpful I would recommend this pet shop and the staff. Mendez and Alex very knowledgeable on the Fish
This is a great little pet shop, great friendly, helpful staff, loads of choice for all sorts of creatures great and small, give them a try we did years ago and can't speak highly enough of it.
Really excellent pet shop, always well stocked & the staff are very helpful. Support Local!
Mendez and Alex served me today, very nice guys, outstanding service and got the pack of pressed bones I was after. Thank you!
Visited today to get some neon's. Really well priced, really friendly and helpful staff. Will come back for future pet needs as I didn't realise this place was here. Definitely worth a visit.
This store is great, really friendly staff. They sell the best cat litter for my indoor cat!
Great pet store,  the guys and girls are so helpful. The raw food I buy is reasonably priced and good quality. Well done Mendez , Alex and the 2 Girls

I highly recommend this shop, Mendez & Alex were both very friendly & helpful.
Got some treats for my dog to try & they gave me 2 free rabbits ears. Will definitely be going back.

A great shop. I’ve been getting my pet fish from here for almost 20 years since I was a kid. They’ve got a decent selection of fish and always help with picking the right fish for the tank. They’re one of the nicer pet fish stores in the area, and reasonably priced.
Very helpful very welcoming great prices highly recommend kiddy and daz very helpful
Lovely shop, we're always in here and they give us really good service. Good value for money :)

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Beacon Pet Aquatics! From the moment I walked in, the staff were absolutely lovely—so welcoming and knowledgeable. They have an incredible selection of everything you need for your pets, whether it’s fish, small animals, or dogs. I was especially impressed by their range of dog treats—they helped me find just the right ones for my sister’s pups that I’m looking after. Big shout-out to Dez, who went above and beyond, even helping me carry a huge bag of food to my car. I’ll definitely be coming back, and I highly recommend them to anyone who loves their pets!
This  shop is Great  the   staff are so friendly and helpfull Dez, Kiddy and Alex,  HIGHLY RECOMMEND !!
Extremely helpful, friendly and knowledgeable staff. A lot easier to talk to and very high quality fish compared to large chain stores.very well priced, no complaints.

I have been using this family run business for many years and have always found the staff to be very knowledgeable and helpful ,the shop provides pretty much all your pet needs and  continues to delivery excellent customer service ,big shout out to Dez and Alex who were both very helpful today upon my visit in assisting me with my tropical fish requirements.

I’m very fussy regarding of dog bones and chews I give my spaniel the lady behind the counter was so helpful knowledgeable and patient and in the end I went for oxtails she has had more since thank you for your help
Lovely staff
